Case Study 1: Multi-Flat Owner Rental (Noida / Greater Noida)
Owner Profile: Col. R. S. Bhatti (Retd. Defense Officer & Multi-Flat Owner)
The Challenge: Burdened by constant spam calls from unverified listing aggregators, fake lead demands, and unauthorized reuse of his flat photos on third-party social media channels.
The Solution: Subscribed to the Prime Listing Package, publishing authentic, on-site captured photos under the platform’s Media Originality Covenant.

The Result: Connected with a verified local Channel Partner. Col. Bhatti retained full authority over physical document checks, employment background checks, and mandatory Police Verification. Both flats were rented out to verified corporate tenants within 14 days with zero legal friction.
Case Study 2: Overcoming Client Bypass in Premium Flat Sales
Location: Noida Sector 62
Partner Profile: Vikram Malhotra (Residential Channel Partner)

The Challenge: Vikram spent weeks showcasing premium 3-BHK luxury flats to high-net-worth buyers, only to be bypassed by the flat owner and buyer right before closing, resulting in lost sales commissions worth lakhs.
The Solution: Onboarded on the Prop-Tech platform, utilizing the mandatory System-Logged Token Amount & Digital Deal Locking workflow before conducting site visits and negotiations.

The Result: Successfully closed a high-value flat sale. The platform’s automated backend logging proved client attribution, preventing bypass. Vikram retained 100% of his negotiated sales brokerage with zero platform deduction, securing ₹3.5 Lakhs in net earnings.
